dog.description_text:
Meet Holly Jolly! Kind and trusting, this lovely 5-year-old, 16 lb Havanese mix is on a mission to make every day feel like a holiday. She is wonderful with new people, greeting friends instantly. She is also eager to say hi to other dogs on walks. Holly is a calm sweetheart who loves rolling over for belly rubs and will happily follow you around like a loyal shadow.

In her foster placement, Holly has been settling in wonderfully and is working on her house routines. She is getting the hang of her crate and she is eager to share her affectionate personality and make friends.

Registered adopters interested in Holly Jolly can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
